beats: Making one of these clips used to mean a laptop had to stay awake all night running tools nothing else needed.
Timing the voice needed those same tools, so an unattended process in a bare container was stuck.
Now GitHub Actions measures the voice from the script already written — no laptop required.
A second run rebuilds that voice and refuses to render if it drifts past six frames.
Two clips have now rendered this way, start to finish, PC switched off.
